name: og-independence
primary_limitation: Independence is graded and attributed, not all-or-nothing; the three support channels are lumped, so the first cut does not resolve independence for H2 / CO2 / organics individually.
key_assumptions: The innovation set is {internal pump, importer, heredity}
Support channels are gradient (pH/pmf), mineral access, and feed (H2+CO2+organics lumped)
Persistence is scored off-gradient against one-at-a-time and joint withdrawal
title: Independence from the Vent: Can a Lineage Escape Its Cradle?
concept: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum set of innovations lets it persist as external support (gradient, mineral access, feed) is withdrawn, and which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies — one concept (Gate E), studied at several fidelities as arms: joint all-at-once escape (og-08), the minimum-sufficient set across model structures (og-08-alt-robust), and the one-at-a-time attributed independence profile (og-37).
gate_reason: Gate E (optional extension), graded autonomy — the terminal arc study (27-37). This consolidates the independence line into one concept with explicit fidelity-labelled arms, each judged against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal: the joint all-at-once escape (og-08, which found a coordinated innovation set but could not ATTRIBUTE which innovation rescues which support, so its general minimal-sufficiency claim is rescoped), the across-structures 2³ subset lattice (og-08-alt-robust, which resolves the set as advantageous but driver-specific — not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit), and the one-at-a-time attributed profile (og-37, canonical). Headline is bounded by the most-caveated honest arm: QUALIFIED — independence is graded and attributed, not an all-or-nothing escape, and the profile is an affordability/attribution map (lumped feed, coarse budget abstractions), not a demonstrated real-cell escape. Each arm keeps its own verdict and matched null (see arms). Guardrail: metabolism is the sustained A1 network, not autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
claim: A vent-born protocell lineage reaches GRADED, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing (and not a free) escape. og-08 withdrew gradient + mineral + feed JOINTLY and found a coordinated innovation set {internal pump, importer, heredity} where any single removal collapses persistence — but joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so that general minimal-sufficiency reading is rescoped to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis (supported within its one coarse model). og-08-alt-robust then tests the set ACROSS model structures on a 2³ subset lattice and resolves it driver-specifically: the {pump, importer, heredity} triple is advantageous but NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit — only pump+heredity interact positively, the active importer is required by no driver (a net cost under a leaky membrane), and the hard dependency is the geological gradient (the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral (0.958) and feed (0.75) are freely/borderline survivable needing no specific innovation. og-37's one-at-a-time withdrawal agrees: the gradient is the budget-sensitive hard dependency (pump-internalization flips below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in the energy arm's persistence-not-throughput surplus), while mineral and feed need no innovation. Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
question: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
hypothesis: A bounded innovation set (internal energy conversion + resource import + heredity) allows graded persistence as gradient / mineral / feed are withdrawn; the set's sufficiency is model-structure-dependent, and each internalizable support is attributable to a specific innovation by a matched ablation. Where no subset persists, or apparent independence is not causally attributable, that is reported honestly rather than tuned to a pass.
experiment: Relax environmental support by ablation sweeps and determine the minimum innovation set for autonomy (og-08, joint); test minimum-sufficiency across model structures against a generic-environment control (og-08-alt-robust); and reuse og-08's validated co-limited off-gradient budget to withdraw each support ONE AT A TIME with matched per-support ablations, attributing each internalizable support to a specific innovation and reporting the honest profile with its lumped-feed and coarse-abstraction limits (og-37).

arms.concept_role: Foundation (plan 8): with ALL geological support (gradient + mineral + feed) withdrawn JOINTLY, what minimum innovation set lets a lineage persist? Realized: the coordinated set {internal pump, importer, heredity} escapes and any single removal collapses it — but the joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so the general minimal-sufficiency claim is RESCOPED (disposition: RESCOPE) to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis, superseded by the og-08-alt-robust and og-37 arms.

Resolving arm — the innovation set tested ACROSS model structures on a 2³ subset lattice: is the triple jointly necessary, or merely advantageous? Realized: advantageous but driver-specific (the superseded og-08 lumped reading, resolved) — only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is required by no driver (a net cost under a leaky membrane), and the hard dependency is the geological gradient; each ledger closed against a generic-environment control.

Canonical terminal arm (Gate E, plan 37): withdrawing each support ONE AT A TIME (where og-08 withdrew them jointly), which supports can the coupled lineage internalize and which stay hard dependencies — each attributed by a matched per-support ablation? Realized: a graded, attributed independence profile the gradient the budget-sensitive hard dependency (pump-internalization flips below pump efficiency ~0.7), while mineral and feed need no innovation and the importer is required by no driver — the triple is advantageous but not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact). Qualified: feed is LUMPED and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions — an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated real-cell escape.

findings.evidence_basis_note: Off-gradient persistence of the full innovation set vs ablated subsets is a model outcome.
findings.statement: Under withdrawing geological support (external gradient, mineral access and feed all relaxed to zero), the full innovation set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0, net budget +0.36) while removing any single innovation collapses persistence to 0 in this joint all-at-once withdrawal — each component is individually necessary here, though the 2³ subset lattice (og-08-alt-robust) resolves the triple as advantageous but driver-specific, NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact; the importer is required by no driver; the hard dependency is the geological gradient).
findings.explanation: Deterministic co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget; as support -> 0 the external tap and ambient substrate both vanish, so persistence needs an internal pump (energy) AND an importer (resource) at once, held by heredity (information maintenance).

findings.statement: In the og-08 joint all-at-once withdrawal (rescoped) the set appears jointly necessary because the budget is co-limited — gross = min(energy, resource). A lone pump raises energy but the resource term still limits growth (and vice versa), so a half-equipped lineage pays an innovation's upkeep without a co-benefit; the survival frontier shows single knockouts needing MORE environmental support than even the bare control over part of the range.

evidence.observed: frontier: full persists to support 0; -pump 0.33, -heredity 0.44, none 0.48, -importer 0.59

findings.explanation: Liebig's law of the minimum — co-limitation means energy and resource cannot substitute for one another, so autonomy requires acquiring both independently of the vent (pump + importer) and holding that machinery (heredity).

findings.statement: Heredity is necessary not as an energy or resource term but as information maintenance — without it the adaptive machinery degrades over the run (machinery integrity 1.0 -> 0.007, an error-catastrophe decay), so the pump and importer cannot be held and the lineage collapses even though it carries them.

evidence.observed: -heredity: machinery integrity 0.007 at run end, survivors 0.0

findings.explanation: The heredity flag gates the per-step machinery decay; without it the innovation terms (pump, importer) scale toward zero as machinery is lost, so the budget falls below the survival floor.

findings.statement: Per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal resolves the attribution confound the original all-at-once relaxation could not. Withdrawing each vent driver alone (the other two held at full) across 24 structures × 3 drivers × 8 innovation subsets: the vent-pmf GRADIENT is a hard dependency — the full innovation set rescues its withdrawal in only 4.2% of structures, and where it does the required set is {pump, heredity}; MINERAL access is freely survivable (0.958, no specific innovation required); FEED is borderline (0.75, no specific innovation required). The required set is therefore DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal {pump, importer, heredity} triple — {pump, heredity} rescues the gradient, mineral and feed need no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The lumped all-at-once run could not attribute because the gradient — rarely survivable, needing pump+heredity — dominated the joint collapse. confound_resolved; differential survivability; ledgers close at every point.

With every driver withdrawn to 1 % of the vent level, none of the eight subsets of {pump, importer, heredity} persists under any of the 24 sampled structures (0 persisting runs of 192); the best full-set lineages end s02 -3.8e-20 W, s21 -1e-19 W, s14 -1e-19 W short, their machinery lost as the cell's organic carbon falls to the floor and the heredity class's precursor pools with it.

evidence.observed: full set persists under 0 of 24 structures at the nominal floor; viable structures 0

findings.explanation: The persistence rule reads the settled work and material budgets with every driver at its floor. Off-gradient the external tap is gone, the store runs on the drive the cell's own H2 / organic pool sustains, and the upkeep (the energy-coupling maintenance at full coupling, 5.1e-18 W) takes most of what the best store delivers; a lineage whose heredity class cannot hold its machinery on a tenth of the carbon loses the pump with it. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice, floor_map).

findings.statement: At a 10 % ocean the only subset that persists is {pump, heredity}, under 2 of 24 structures (s16 (thioester acyl phosphate store, hybrid heredity, mixed boundary at the measured anchor, constant upkeep; net 9.5e-19 W, machinery 0.93, autonomy 1); s19 (thioester acyl phosphate store, rna like heredity, single chain boundary at the extrapolated anchor, constant upkeep; net 1.2e-18 W, machinery 0.97, autonomy 0.99)); the full set persists under 0. Over the viable structures the required intersection is {pump, heredity} and the importer is required in 0 of them: in the same structures the full set runs a deficit because the importer costs more than it returns (s16: net -4.9e-19 W with the importer on, its cost 1.7e-18 W; s19: net -1.1e-18 W with the importer on, its cost 1.9e-18 W).

evidence.observed: rich-floor lattice: pump+heredity 2/24, full set 0/24; required intersection [pump, heredity], union [pump, heredity]

findings.explanation: The ActiveUptakeRule concentrates organics to 30 % of the vent level against the membrane's leak at the thermodynamic cost RT ln(c_in/c_out) per mole over a 0.5 efficiency, spending up to 30 % of the work supply; with the drive already saturated by ocean H2 (K 10 uM) the imported organics add nothing to the budget, so the importer is a pure cost under the ecology-stage extrapolated leak. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich, discrimination_rich).

findings.statement: The storage model reproduces the energy-store result inside the world — the H+/Na+ gradient store never charges at the fatty-acid leak and polyphosphate never clears its 30 kJ/mol load, while the four stores deliver at most 0 (polyphosphate), 0 (H+/Na+ gradient), 6.6e-18 (thioester) and 5e-18 W (Fe-redox) — and the inheritance class reproduces the heredity stage's budget sensitivity: settled machinery off-gradient at the rich floor is hybrid 0.77, mineral state 0.74, rna like 0.41, compositional 0.27, network 0, peptide 0; peptide and network hold none, the templated classes decay as the carbon falls, the mineral and compositional classes hold on a fraction of the budget.

evidence.observed: internal power by storage class and machinery by inheritance class over the full-set runs at the rich floor

findings.explanation: The structural axes do what the earlier studies found when their classes are composed: the autonomy question factors into "can the store run the lineage" (the energy-store question) and "can the inheritance class hold the machinery on what the cell makes off-gradient" (the heredity question). Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich.by_axis).

findings.statement: Off-gradient the lineages supply essentially all of their own work, material and catalysis — the persisting ones at work 1, material 0.99, information 0.89 (total 0.99); the full-set lineages at a mean total autonomy of 0.93 against 0.71 in the vent, where the tap supplies the work (work autonomy 0.054) — and most of them still cannot pay for themselves.

evidence.observed: autonomy (work / material / information / total) of persisting and of all full-set runs at the rich floor; in-vent values

findings.explanation: The continuous autonomy value is a share (internal / total); once the tap and the pore feed are withdrawn every surviving supply is internal, so autonomy saturates while the absolute budget can still be negative. Autonomy and sufficiency are different quantities. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (autonomy_rich).

findings.statement: All seven ledgers close on every one of the 485 runs (carbon 1.7e-10, N 1.4e-14, P 1.5e-14, free energy 4.4e-14, information store 1.1e-14, rewrite 4.9e-32, charge 4.7e-14, element 0); 40441 structural events were logged (22365 divisions, 724 extinctions); the og-adv generic control (every driver at its floor from t = 0, no pore concentration) persists under 0/24 structures. The vg-data package carries 32 parameters: 5 calibrated (the vent posterior), 4 inferred, 3 extrapolated, 20 hypothetical, none unsourced.

evidence.observed: ledger ok on 485/485 runs; generic persists 0/24; audit {measured: 0, calibrated: 5, inferred: 4, extrapolated: 3, hypothetical: 20}

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the verdict rests on the 20 hypothetical numbers.

findings.statement: One-at-a-time, each of the 3 support channels is internalizable with the full innovation set (gradient / mineral / feed survivors all 1.00, budget margins +0.26 above the floor — transparent, not knife-edge) and the matched 2³ subset lattice resolves the attribution driver-specifically: the triple is advantageous but NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit — only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is required by no driver, mineral and feed need no innovation, and the hard dependency is the geological gradient (rescued by pump-internalization, which flips below pump efficiency ~0.7). og-08's all-at-once relaxation cannot make this attribution — it escapes only with the full set and fails if ANY innovation is removed — so the subset lattice and one-at-a-time rebuild resolve the confound. So the lineage achieves a graded, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing escape.

The gradient (pH/pmf drive) is the budget-sensitive support: its pump-internalization is affordable only for catalyst_efficiency >= ~0.7 and flips to a hard dependency below that (survivors 0 at efficiency <= 0.6, 1.0 at >= 0.7). This is grounded in study-35's persistence-not-throughput result — the internal carrier has limited surplus — so at a less efficient pump the vent's gradient drive is the hard dependency. Mineral and feed need no innovation (robust across the sweep; the importer is required by no driver). The result is reported as a located boundary, not a knife-edge pass.

Honest scope: the three channels are gradient (pH/pmf), mineral_access (mineral catalysis) and feed (H2+CO2+organics LUMPED), so the first cut does NOT resolve independence for H2 / CO2 / organics individually; and the innovations (pump/importer/heredity) are coarse budget abstractions from og-08, so the result is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. The gold-standard follow-on og-37a resolves the feed per-feedstock, adds temperature as an Arrhenius rate modifier, and runs the combinatorial multi-withdrawal with resolved internalization chemistry.
